capability: A health checker that only looks
title: Let the check only look.

hook.picture: Close on the whale reading a report card from a checker pod. Behind it, the pod's fin is bending the line it is checking. The report and the line disagree: copper ✕.
hook.words: The report says all is well.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The health check fixed things while it checked them. Now nothing matches.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: ops lead reading the Monday report

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: three checker runs. The first reaches into the line while reading; its report describes a line that is no longer there (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Looking and fixing got mixed up.

stakes.body: A report nobody can repeat. Leaders act on numbers that describe a workspace that no longer exists.

metaphor.body: A gate splits the checker in two: a reading part inside that only rings the line, and a thin outer layer, behind the gate, that is the only part allowed to touch files. Copper alarm.

steps.picture: A gate drops between the checker and the line. On the inside, the reading part has no fins, only a ring.
steps.words: Look first. Change nothing while looking.

steps.picture: The reading part rings each repo on the line and writes a score. The line does not move at all.
steps.words: Same line in, same score out.

steps.picture: Push-in: the reading part reaches toward a file. There is no door on its side of the gate. Only the thin outer layer can open files.
Labels: the inside is the pure core, the outside the shell.
steps.words: A pure core inside a thin shell.

real_case.claim: maat replaces a hard-to-test bash script (hard-coded paths, side effects mixed with logic) with a pure core and an I/O shell. README example test: calculateHealthScore(7, 10) gives 70.

honest_limit.picture: A repo with a problem the ideal never names (a stale branch nobody owns) gets rung and scores full marks. The counter glows. The problem sits in plain view.
honest_limit.words: It only scores what the ideal names.

not_this.body: A high score is not good code.

ending_pattern.body: The same report-reading shot as act 1, but the water behind the card is perfectly still. The report and the line match.
ending_pattern.callback: Act 1's line bending behind the report now lies still and matches it.

end_belief.body: A checker should never change what it checks.

score_self.reason: "The checker changed what it checked" is a real and vivid pain. The case number is only a README example, so it is labelled Illustration. "Pure core" is precise but may not land with leaders.
